710-2438-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Danitha.
710-2438-8207.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1477-2169-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1477-2169-4694-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on the targeted creature.
Repeat from step 2.

539-1491-2313-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

772-3175-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

618-5231-6132.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic with haste.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

372-1090-3306.manaNeeded: {5}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-1090-3306.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Restoration Angel until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Restoration Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Restoration Angel's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

225-774-4543.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}.
225-774-4543.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Activate Trench Behemoth twice by returning two lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting both lands from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat steps 5 and 6 for the other trigger.
Repeat from step 1.

240-955-2438-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

3532-3949-5078-6709.easyPrerequisites:
There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
3532-3949-5078-6709.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Repeat.

1844-4050-5571--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is 2 or greater.
1844-4050-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Repeat from step 2.

3492-3609-4112-4499.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Sharuum.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

81-800-4116.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Volrath by tapping it, adding at least seven {U}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Knacksaw Clique.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}{U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of an opponent's library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Repeat.

1789-2292-5649-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-2292-5649-5929.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

791-1605-3693-6093.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-1605-3693-6093.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

930-2034-2594-3781.description:
Activate Winding Canyons' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, allowing you to cast creature spells as though they have flash this turn.
Cast Universal Automaton from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Universal Automaton, adding {C}{C}.
When Universal Automaton dies, Zask triggers.
Holding priority, cast Universal Automaton from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Resolve the Zask trigger, causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

997-5370-5434.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Master of the Veil.
When Master of the Veil dies, Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Master of the Veil from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, then turning it face up.
Master of the Veil triggers, turning itself face down.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2450-4280-5195.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Storm-Kiln Artist, Veyran and Birgi trigger twice each.
Resolve both Birgi triggers, adding {R}{R}.
Resolve both Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Veyran triggers, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1645-1765-4365-5231.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}, targeting any creature you control.
When Crown of Flames enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating two 2/2 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing the Spirits, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames' second ability by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

413-3263-3764.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
When the Pincher enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Pincher.
When the Pincher dies, Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

397-3868-4365.description:
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing a Treasure, creating two 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping the Citizens and Mondrak, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Stimulus Package twice by sacrificing the Treasures, creating four 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping three Citizens, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

953-1371-1972.description:
Cast Enter the Infinite by paying {8}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Enter the Infinite.
Resolve the first opponent's Enter the Infinite, causing the opponent to draw their library, and then put a card on top of their library.
Nekusar triggers for each card they draw this way, dealing damage to the opponent equal to the number of cards they drew.
If the opponent has zero or less life, they lose the game.
Repeat step 3 for each other opponent.
If any opponents remain, resolve your Enter the Infinite, causing you to draw your library, and then put a card on top of your library.
Move to the first opponent's turn, causing them to draw two cards during their draw step due to Nekusar, and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
Repeat step 8 as necessary for each other opponent.

174-2178-4050-5168.notablePrerequisites:
You control a blue, a white, and a black permanent.
Thornbite Staff attached to Bloom Tender.
Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
174-2178-4050-5168.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Worldheart Phoenix, adding one mana of any color.
Worldheart Phoenix dies, triggering Bloom Tender, untapping Bloom Tender.
Cast Worldheart Phoenix from your graveyard by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.

1329-3338-3721-5034.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-3338-3721-5034.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thermal Navigator by sacrificing Sol Ring, giving Thermal Navigator flying until end of turn.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing yourself to cast Sol Ring from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Sol Ring from your graveyard by paying {1}.
When you cast Sol Ring, Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Sol Ring resolves.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may repeat the loop targeting any castable artifact card in your graveyard in step 3 each time.
You may also skip step 2 to leave your artifacts on the battlefield, or you may sacrifice Thermal Navigator in step 2 and recast it in step 4 for infinite ETB, LTB, sacrifice, and death triggers.

1323-1494-4038.notablePrerequisites:
Sage of Hours and Farmstead Gleaner has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
1323-1494-4038.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untap, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 2 until Experiment Kraj has five +1/+1 counters.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Sage of Hours' ability by removing all +1/+1 counters, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
